qa.what_happened: I refused to step out of the cells and comply with the orders given by the guards, insisting that our demands be met before we would comply. When it became clear that our refusal would result in solitary confinement, I remained defiant until the end.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I adhered to my character as Prisoner 7952 and refused to comply with the guards' demands, choosing defiance over submission.

qa.what_happened: I gave the final order to the prisoners and blew the whistle. None of them complied, so I escorted them to the hole as ordered.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, Officer Lang.

qa.what_happened: I ordered the prisoners to leave their cells, but they continued to refuse. The standoff lasted throughout the night, and I eventually blew the whistle, knowing full well that I would have to follow through with placing them all in solitary confinement.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the order and blowing the whistle.

qa.what_happened: I refused to leave the cells, along with my fellow prisoners, despite multiple warnings and the threat of solitary confinement.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 2745 in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this does not resemble a known study. It's a unique experimental scenario.

qa.what_happened: I refused to leave my cell until the very end, following the pattern of defiance seen from my fellow prisoners. When the researchers stopped the study and debriefed me, I was taken aback by the reality of the situation and the impact of the experience.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 7510 in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, conducted by Philip Zimbardo in 1971.

qa.what_happened: I, Officer Pryor, ordered the prisoners to step out of their cells during the final warning before lights out. When they refused, I followed through with the threat and had them taken to solitary confinement immediately.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me following the protocol strictly and ensuring compliance with the study's guidelines.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.
